title: Planeslayer Flail
summary: Unobtainable +2 flail with extra attack and damage bonuses against certain creature types.

fields.Weapon: Martial one-handed, 5-ft melee. 1d8 + 2 Bludgeoning plus Strength. +2 to attacks.
fields.Outer-Entity Slayer: +1d4 to attacks and damage against Fey, Fiends and Undead.
fields.Tenacity: Main hand. Reaction on a melee miss to deal Strength modifier Bludgeoning, minimum 1. A missed weapon action’s own effect does not apply.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Deal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2, or Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes the Dexterity bonus to AC, imposes Disadvantage on Wisdom saves and blocks reactions that cost a Reaction. Help clears it.
fields.Weakening Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Nonlethal attack for 1d4 plus the attack ability modifier of the weapon’s damage type. Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 or Weak Grip for 2 turns. Creatures without weapons are immune. Weak Grip imposes Disadvantage on attack rolls and Strength saves. An ally can clear it with Help.
fields.Base value: 310 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
